⚡ HACKNOVATE 8.0 | AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY

THE CODE
ANSWERS TO
DOOM.

HACKNOVATE 8.0: When the World Needs Its Greatest Minds.

The multiverse is on the brink of destruction. Timelines are collapsing, realities are colliding, and an unprecedented threat is approaching. The fate of the world is no longer in the hands of superheroes alone. It needs innovators, creators, and problem-solvers.

Calling all coders, developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts!

HACKNOVATE 8.0 invites you to assemble your ultimate team, enter the battle of innovation, and build solutions powerful enough to face the impossible.

The countdown has begun. The multiverse needs a new generation of heroes. Are you ready to answer the call?

⚡ THE AVENGERS INITIATIVE

⚡

A high-intensity hacking experience driven by creativity, logic, and innovation.

⚔️

Doomsday-inspired challenges that test your intelligence and problem-solving abilities.

🏆

A massive prize pool of INR 20 Lakhs, along with exciting rewards and recognition.

🤝

Mentorship and networking opportunities with industry experts and fellow innovators.

🚀

An opportunity to build technology-driven solutions for real-world challenges.

🌍 EVENT DETAILS

📍

LOCATION

ABES Institute of Technology, Ghaziabad, NCR

📅

DATES

15–16 February 2027

💻

MODE

Hybrid – Online and Offline

🏆

TOTAL PRIZE POOL

INR 20 Lakhs

⚔️ THE AVENGERS CODE: RULES OF ENGAGEMENT

01 Follow the Code of Conduct. Unethical hacking, plagiarism, and misconduct will not be tolerated.

02 Originality, fair play, and collaboration are mandatory.

03 Respect fellow participants, mentors, organisers, and judges.

04 All submissions must comply with the official hackathon guidelines.

05 Push boundaries, think beyond dimensions, and innovate responsibly.

⚠️ THE FINAL BATTLE BEGINS.

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM.
ACTIVATE YOUR SYSTEMS.

Assemble your team. Activate your systems. Prepare for the unexpected.

One world. Countless possibilities. One mission.

The multiverse doesn’t need another spectator. It needs its next generation of innovators.

ARE YOU WORTHY OF THE CHALLENGE?

WHEN WORLDS COLLIDE,
INNOVATION RISES.

THE MULTIVERSE IS AT STAKE. IT’S TIME TO ASSEMBLE.

Welcome to HACKNOVATE 8.0 – AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY.
